en.explanation:
Given, V = 10–3 m3 = Al

I = 0.5A

r = 1000

n = 10 turns/cm = turn/m = 1000 turn/m

Magnetic moment, M = NIA(r - 1)

= (nl)IA(r - 1)

= nI(Al)(r - 1)

= 1000 × 0.5 × 10–3 (1000 – 1)

= 0.5 × (999) = 499.5

500 = 5 102 Am2

(ignore viscosity of air)
